target_truth_policy: A-P class_label=UNKNOWN_TRUTH and label_status=unknown_truth are boundary sentinels only; no target fault label may enter fitting, tuning, selection, validation metrics, or final claims.

candidates.retained_source_parts: exact 07-A H1_RF classifier, 26-feature order, class order and file aggregation
candidates.objective: closed-form interpolation toward source file-balanced feature moments; no target labels and no iterative fitting

candidates.retained_source_parts: exact 07-A H1_RF classifier; only target features are transformed
candidates.objective: target-to-source covariance alignment in source-standardized space using regularized symmetric covariance square roots

candidates.retained_source_parts: 07-A RF family/hyperparameters, 26 features, class order and aggregation; classifier is refit on source labels only with unsupervised domain-ratio source weights
candidates.objective: file/class-balanced source RF empirical risk multiplied by clipped p(target|x)/p(source|x) weights from a domain-only logistic classifier

pseudo_label_policy.reason: 08-A no-transfer A-P predictions occupy only OR/B while target truth is unknown; self-training would risk reinforcing source bias. No selected 09-A candidate requires pseudo-labels.
pseudo_label_policy.threshold_sensitivity: not_applicable; explicitly logged rather than fabricated

pseudo_target_protocol.label_visibility: hidden from all adaptation functions; revealed only after prediction for evaluation

selection.tuning_only_rule: All T2/T3 config selection and family selection use only loads 0/1/2 under the primary seed. Load3 is never consulted until family/config are frozen.
family_rank: complexity preference T1 then T2 then T3

A_P_safety_only_not_selection.rule: If the already-selected method causes severe A-P output collapse, fail 09-A; do not switch methods by inspecting A-P appearance.

source_retention.T1_T2: exact source classifier is unchanged; verify serialized source classifier SHA and source prediction identity by construction
source_retention.T3: if selected, evaluate 4 frozen outer source folds with A-P unlabeled domain weights; compare to 07-A H1_RF frozen OOF

domain_gap_evidence.metric: biased RBF MMD2 on independent-file mean vectors in source-standardized 26-D space
domain_gap_evidence.T1_T2: compare source vs adapted target file means
domain_gap_evidence.T3: compare target vs domain-weighted source file means
domain_gap_evidence.warning: lower MMD is evidence of distribution proximity only, never proof of diagnostic correctness

final_real_target_run: After family/config is frozen and held-load3 acceptance passes, apply exactly once to all 240 unlabeled A-P windows; save pre/post scores/predictions and final transfer bundle. No target accuracy/F1/Recall.
